files_summary.papers.json: Dictionary of real arXiv papers keyed by arXiv ID string. Each value has exactly: id, title, authors (list[str]), categories (list[str] of valid arXiv category codes), published (YYYY-MM-DD), summary (1-2 sentence abstract), markdown (title H1 + Abstract + section headers). Spans NLP (Transformers/BERT/GPT/T5/BART/word2vec/ELMo/UniLM/Transformer-XL), computer vision (ViT/YOLO/ResNet/GANs/DDPM/U-Net/StyleGAN/CLIP/DALL-E/CycleGAN/MobileNet/EfficientNet/DINO/SimCLR/MoCo), generative models (VAE, latent/Stable Diffusion), reinforcement learning (PPO/DQN/SAC/DDPG/MAML), optimization (Adam/BatchNorm), model compression (distillation, quantization), graph learning (GCN/GraphSAGE/Deep Sets), speech (wav2vec 2.0), recommenders (NCF/Wide&Deep), few-shot learning (Prototypical/Matching Networks), and generalization theory. All IDs, titles, first authors, categories, and dates are real.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: arxiv_search_papers
tool_schemas.description: Searches arXiv for papers matching the provided query, optionally constrained by date range, categories, and a maximum number of results, and returns the matching paper metadata. It refuses requests with a missing or empty query, with invalid filter values (for example non-integer max_results, malformed dates, or non-string categories), or with an invalid date range (date_from after date_to). It may also refuse requests that ask for an unreasonably large max_results beyond the service’s allowed limit.

tool_schemas.name: arxiv_download_paper
tool_schemas.description: Downloads the arXiv paper identified by paper_id, converts it to a stored markdown resource when possible, and returns the resource/conversion status; if check_status is true, it only reports the current conversion status without starting a new download. It refuses requests that omit paper_id, use an invalid or malformed arXiv identifier, or reference a paper that cannot be fetched from arXiv. It also refuses requests that conflict with the paper’s current state, such as attempting to start a download/conversion while one is already in progress or when the paper is already available and no new work is needed.

paper_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper to download

check_status.description: If true, only check conversion status without downloading

tool_schemas.name: arxiv_list_papers
tool_schemas.description: Lists papers that already exist as stored resources, returning a paginated set of paper metadata with optional sorting and filters (category, author, and free-text q). It refuses requests with invalid pagination inputs (limit less than 1, or an unrecognized/expired cursor) or invalid sort settings (sort_by/sort_order outside the allowed values). It also refuses filter values that don’t meet the endpoint’s validation rules (for example non-string category/author/q).

limit.description: Maximum number of papers to return (pagination limit).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

category.description: Filter results to papers that include this arXiv category (exact match).

author.description: Filter results to papers that include this author string (exact match).

q.description: Free-text filter applied to title and summary.

tool_schemas.name: arxiv_read_paper
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full markdown content for a previously stored paper resource identified by paper_id. It refuses requests that omit paper_id, use an invalid arXiv identifier, or reference a paper that has not been downloaded/converted into a stored markdown resource. It may also refuse reads while the paper is still being processed and the markdown content is not yet available.

paper_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper to read

metadata.name: Helios Paper Vault
metadata.description: A backend service that lets users search arXiv, download papers into a managed library, list stored documents, and read them as markdown resources via a simple API.
